# Jod profile: Acme Billing (example)

<!-- An example profile for an established TypeScript monorepo. Yours is generated by /jod:setup. -->

## How we work
- Mode: `established`. 3 years and 2,400 commits; patterns are consistent; money flows.
- Plan approval: `fast path for small changes`.
- Tests: `test-first where it pays` (logic, bugs, money, permissions).

## Conventions
- API errors: throw `HttpException` subclasses; the global filter shapes the response.
- Web data: React Query through `lib/api-client.ts`, never `fetch()` in components.
- Forms: `@tanstack/react-form` + Zod. Legacy, don't copy: Formik in `apps/web/src/legacy/`.
- Money: integer cents, rounded with `lib/money.ts`.

## Stack
- pnpm 9 + Turborepo. Conventions: `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/architecture.md`.
- `apps/api`: NestJS + Postgres (Prisma); Jest specs next to the source.
- `apps/web`: Next.js App Router; Jest in `src/__tests__/`.
- `packages/shared`: types, permissions, plan limits.

## Layers (in build order)
1. `packages/shared` → `pnpm --filter shared build`
2. `apps/api/src/<module>/` (DTO, service, controller, spec), plus a Prisma migration if the schema changes
3. `pnpm gen` (OpenAPI → `apps/web/src/gen`; never hand-edit it)
4. `apps/web` (page, hook, component, test)
5. `docs/` (public API docs)

## Verify commands
| Package | Typecheck | Tests |
|---|---|---|
| api | `pnpm --filter api typecheck` | `pnpm --filter api test -- <paths>` |
| web | `pnpm --filter web typecheck` | `pnpm --filter web test -- <paths>` |

Full gate: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm turbo typecheck test build --continue`

## Branches and release
- Work on `development`; only `/jod:ship` merges it into `main`. CI deploys on push to `main`, so confirm timing.
- Commit style: `feat(scope): …`. Never stage `.env*`.

## Production
- Runtime: Kubernetes. Definition: `k8s/overlays/prod` (kustomize). Images built by CI from `apps/*/Dockerfile`.
- Start command: the Deployment's `node dist/main.js` (api) and `node server.js` (web, Next.js standalone).
- Health: api `GET /health` (:4000), web `GET /api/health` (:3000). Smoke: `GET /invoices?limit=1` with the seed admin token.
- Production env example: `apps/api/.env.production.example`.
- Migrations: the `prisma-migrate` Job runs before the rollout.
- Cluster access for dry runs: none (`kubectl apply --dry-run=client` + kubeconform).

## Local environment
- Claude may start the dev servers (`pnpm dev`; web :3000, API :4000).
- Database: local Docker Postgres (`docker compose up db`), seeded with `pnpm db:seed`.
- Feedback tools: API logs in `apps/api/logs/dev.log`; emails print to stdout in dev.

## High-risk areas
- `apps/api/src/billing/` (Stripe webhooks, invoices), `apps/api/src/auth/`, `packages/shared/src/permissions.ts`

## Reference implementations
- Module: `apps/api/src/invoices/`
- Paginated list: `invoices/dto/list-invoices.dto.ts`
- Idempotent webhook handler: `billing/stripe-webhook.service.ts`
- Form dialog: `apps/web/src/components/invoices/create-invoice-dialog.tsx`

## Hands-off
- `apps/web/src/components/ui/` (shadcn), `apps/web/src/gen/`

## Gotchas
- `pnpm test` at the root passes `--continue` to Jest; use `pnpm turbo test --continue`.
